issues.description: The problem statement contains conflicting information about the visibility of Farm.singFarmSongVerse(Animal): the UML diagram lists singFarmSongVerse as private, but the textual instructions explicitly ask students to implement singFarmSongVerse(Animal) as public for easier testing. The template and the provided solution both implement singFarmSongVerse as private. This contradiction between the UML and the textual instruction can confuse students about the intended visibility and may lead to mismatches with tests or grading expectations.
issues.suggestedFix: Resolve the visibility contradiction: either (A) update the problem statement text to remove the instruction to make singFarmSongVerse public (so it matches the UML and the template/solution implementations), or (B) change the UML and the template/solution to mark singFarmSongVerse as public and update the method signature accordingly. Prefer clarifying the problem statement to match the current template/solution (private), or if tests require public, update the template and solution method declarations to public and adjust visibility in the UML.
